login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter the sign-in details for your restaurant's panel.

forgot.sentSubtitle: If the account exists, a link to reset the password is on its way.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email address linked to your account and we will send you a link to set a new password.

reset.noTokenSubtitle: This address does not contain a reset token.

reset.title: Set a new password

activate.noTokenSubtitle: This address does not contain an activation token.

appearance.logoHint: PNG or JPG, ideally square. It appears in the menu header and in your QR codes.

pattern.title: Background pattern
pattern.hint: A subtle motif in the background — dishes then get their own cards, so everything stays readable.

starter.title: Let's start with categories

center.addLogo: Add a logo on the “Menu design” tab

languages.subtitle: Show guests the menu in their own language. The map shows where it can already be read — add languages where your guests come from.
languages.addedReady: Added: {{name}}. The translations are ready — guests can see it now.
languages.addedTranslate: Added: {{name}}. Guests can see it now — next, translate your menu into it.
languages.hidden: Hidden: {{name}}. The translations stay — you can bring it back at any time.
languages.yoursHint: Guests see these languages in the menu's switcher.
languages.addHint: Hover over a language and the map shows where new readers appear.
languages.translationsHint: The machine suggests — you have the final word. Nothing reaches guests before you save.

languages.discardBody: You have unsaved changes in this language. If you switch to another, they will be lost.

reach.notInCatalogue: The local language is not in the catalogue yet.
reach.mapAria: World map: countries where guests can read your menu

offered.onlyPolish: Guests see the menu in Polish only. Start with English — most foreign guests read it.
offered.done: Done — guests read the whole menu in this language.
offered.untranslated: Not translated — guests see the menu {{fallback}}.
offered.work: Every new dish means up to {{translations}} translations — name, description and ingredients {{inLanguages}}.
offered.many: That is {{languages}} already. Each one more adds work to every menu change, and an unfinished one shows guests a half-and-half menu. Only add the ones your guests really need.

addLanguage.sortHint: Biggest gain first: how many new people can read your menu once the language is added.
addLanguage.allRecommended: You already have every recommended language. You will find others on the “All” tab.
addLanguage.noSuch: There is no such language in the catalogue.
addLanguage.prepared: You already have {{done}} of {{total}} translations — they come back straight away.
